claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.77 Project Management ZIP/log audit that reached ready export with 12/12 materials and only the scored texture finding remaining after the false native-fallback P2 was removed.
The native-fallback caveat detector now requires explicit native fallback wording instead of matching any caveat that contains the word prose.
A regression recreates the live texture-warning message and proves it does not create a native fallback finding, while the existing explicit fallback regression still fires.
The release notes explicitly carry forward the real texture 83/100 loss and do not claim a clean 100/100 package.
